name: Planting Justice Youth Internships
what_you_do: You do a paid youth internship at an urban farm and nursery. You learn sustainable farming, food distribution and school gardens. You get job training. You get food safety certifications. Community mentors help you.
who_can_apply: Fall 2026: Sobrante Park and East Oakland youth ages 15 to 18, and past Planting Justice interns. It is for youth facing hard times such as hunger or no home, and it aims to keep them in school.
pay_detail: Fall 2026: $25 per hour for 14 hours, based on finishing all the work. The usual rate on the page is $17.50 per hour (page says 40+ paid internships)
deadline_text: Fall 2026: apply by Wednesday, Nov 4, 2026 at 4 pm. You hear back Nov 13. Later rounds are not posted.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online form and the liability waiver linked on it. You need both. For other rounds, email your resume to jobs@plantingjustice.org. Or call the East Oakland Nursery at 510-756-6965.
notes: The Fall 2026 round is a paid art and poetry project about the Sobrante Park fruit trees. You must come all 3 days and get your own ride. Lunch is provided. The form's Spanish text adds a required orientation on Nov 20 and lists different end times, so ask. Ages and hours for other rounds are not stated. Pay may change.
